error[L0102]: Landin writes `not` for logical negation, not `!`
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/foreign-prefix-not-is-named/program.ldn:2:12
  |
2 |     r = if !a then 1 else 2 end if
  |            ^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/foreign-prefix-not-is-named/program.ldn:2:9
  |
2 |     r = if !a then 1 else 2 end if
  |         ^^ required by this
  = note: [0340]: `not condition` reverses a boolean condition; `!` declares a function's error channel, not negation
  = help: write `not`
